metadata.cpu: AMD Ryzen 9 PRO 7940HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics
metadata.method: Eight serial rounds alternate before/after order. A pilot calibrates identical iteration counts within each pair for a 1.5-second target; every timed window must exceed one second. Workers warm up to 20 calls. Exact output hashes must match within each engine. PHP tracing JIT is required. Median per-round ratios and their full ranges describe these samples; they are not significance tests. Six cases are reported without multiple-comparison adjustment. The host is shared and CPU affinity applies to compiler and GC threads.

publication_note: Absolute paths removed from metadata for publication; original raw measurements remain local.
